Thanks for the mapping images, Razer version, and the report that a later test ran for several minutes without changes. I inspected the attached v0.97.2 report: it contains two KeyboardManagerEngine crashes with exception c0000409, but the stack is unresolved and the archive does not show whether either crash coincided with a failed remap.

Could you please:
1. Retest the same numeric-key automation on v0.102.3001.
2. If the remaps revert or the engine exits, comment /bugreport immediately afterward and include the local occurrence time before restarting.
This will tell us whether the old engine crash remains and whether it explains the remapping failure.
